title: Utho sakina chalo
body:
lipat ke turbat se boli maadar
utho sakina chalo watan ko
rehaai zindan se paayi dilbar
utho sakina chalo....
<<DIVIDER>>
ye poochti thi bahut tha armaan
reha kab honge yahan se amma
wo waqt ab aa gaya meinassar
utho sakina chalo....
<<DIVIDER>>
ye neend kaisi hai aankhein kholo
pukarti hoo mai kab se bolo
khudara khao taras ye maa par
utho sakina chalo....
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare dukh se mareez bhai
jhukaye sar deta hai duhaai
phupi bhi dekho hai kitni muztar
utho sakina chalo....
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan pe hai dard kuch batao
ghareeb maa ko na yun rulao
galay se lag jao mere uth kar
utho sakina chalo....
<<DIVIDER>>
safar yahan se hai karbala ka
wahan pe ammu se karna shikwa
waheen pe tum ko milega asghar
utho sakina chalo....
<<DIVIDER>>
hui ho jab se khamosh beta
na jaane phat'ta hai kyun kaleja
ajeeb zindan ka hai ye manzar
utho sakina chalo....
<<DIVIDER>>
baghair tere ho kaise jaana
basayenge hum bhi qaid khana
mai kaise jaungi payshe sarwar
utho sakina chalo....
<<DIVIDER>>
anees qaide sitam ki haalat
na pooch barpa thi ek qayamat
rabab kehti thi jab tadap kar
utho sakina chalo....
author: Anees
